name: LIC unclaimed policy dues
goal: This is LIC's official 'Unclaimed Policy Dues' search form. It needs any two of: policy number, name, date of birth, PAN. Fill policyholder name '{name}' and date of birth '{dob}' (dd/mm/yyyy); also fill PAN '{pan}' and policy number '{policy_no}' only if they are not 'not provided'. Do not invent any value. Click Submit once. If a CAPTCHA, OTP or login appears, stop immediately and say so in message — never try to solve it. Report whether any unclaimed amount is listed; copy the holder name exactly as shown into holder_name only if a record is listed. Return JSON only.
heal_hints: The form may be inside the page body below the header; scroll down.
Date of birth may need dd/mm/yyyy format with slashes.
claim_how: Visit any LIC branch with the policy bond (or indemnity), ID, bank details and, for a deceased policyholder, the death certificate and legal-heir proof.
engine_note: Playbook on TinyFish Browser (Indian exit IP); Agent as self-heal fallback

name: Tata AIA Life — unclaimed policy funds
goal: This is Tata AIA Life Insurance's official unclaimed-funds search. Keep 'Individual Policy' selected. Type the policy holder name '{name}' and the date of birth '{dob}' (DD/MM/YYYY) into the two fields, then click Proceed once. Do not invent any value. If a CAPTCHA, OTP or login appears, stop immediately and say so in message — never try to solve it. Report whether any unclaimed fund is listed; copy the holder name exactly as shown into holder_name only if a record is listed. Return JSON only.
heal_hints: The date field may open a calendar; type the date as DD/MM/YYYY and press Escape to close it.
claim_how: Raise the claim on the Tata AIA customer portal or at a branch with the policy number, KYC, bank details and (for a deceased policyholder) the death certificate. No fee.
engine_note: TinyFish Agent with live browser view; playbook fallback

name: SBI Life — unclaimed amount disclosure
human_note: SBI Life's search has a CAPTCHA. JAAGRUK never solves CAPTCHAs: open the assisted session, JAAGRUK fills the name and date of birth, you type the CAPTCHA.
claim_how: Contact SBI Life customer service or a branch with the policy details; claims are free.
evidence: Live test 2026-10-19: a TinyFish agent run (22 steps) reached the form and stopped at a CAPTCHA — so this portal is citizen-assisted.

name: IEPF — unclaimed shares & dividends
claim_how: File form IEPF-5 online on the IEPF portal; there is no fee and no time limit.
human_note: The IEPF search now sits behind an MCA login. Open the assisted session and sign in with your own MCA account; JAAGRUK then fills the search by name and state.
evidence: Live test 2026-10-19: the search page redirects to the MCA login (agent run timed out after 83 steps), so this portal is citizen-assisted.

name: RBI UDGAM — unclaimed bank deposits
human_note: UDGAM needs your own mobile OTP. Open the assisted session: JAAGRUK fills the form, you type the OTP.
claim_how: Claim at the bank shown in the result using the UDRN reference; there is no time limit.

name: SEBI MITRA — inactive mutual fund folios
human_note: MF Central login with your own OTP is required. Open the assisted session to search MITRA.
claim_how: Contact the AMC or registrar (CAMS/KFintech) shown in the result.

name: EPFO — provident fund balance
human_note: Needs the member's UAN and OTP. Use the assisted session, or the family claims via the employer.
claim_how: Nominees file Form 20 (PF), 10D (pension) and 5IF (EDLI) via the employer or the EPFO portal.

name: myScheme official eligibility checker
goal: This is the official myScheme eligibility checker. It shows one Yes/No question at a time; answer each using ONLY these facts about the applicant: {facts}. Read each question carefully — e.g. 'Does your income exceed ₹X?' must be answered by comparing the applicant's income with X. If a question is not covered by the facts, choose the answer a typical applicant would give and list that question under unanswered. Click Submit after each answer. Copy the final verdict text exactly into verdict_text; if the site shows an error such as 'Something went wrong', copy that error. Return JSON only.
evidence: Live probe 2026-10-19 (TinyFish Browser, IN): 7 progressive Yes/No questions; the final Submit returned 'We're Sorry! Something went wrong'.
